decided: A program is not finished, and its brief is not saved or offered for sign-off, while any active change still belongs to it, even a change filed under a stage the program does not declare or under no stage.
alternatives: look only at the declared stages, so open work filed elsewhere would not stop the program from being called finished
why: The user should sign a program only when none of its work is still open; the program brief already lists such changes, so a signature given then would cover unfinished work.
